name: mcp-diya-gl
title: diya-gl's MCP server, inspected
description: A look under the hood: the diya-gl accounting engine answering a developer tool (MCP Inspector) over the Model Context Protocol, reading a real example set of accounts.

localApp.readyPattern: MCP Inspector Web is up and running

steps.caption: diya-gl runs your accounts. This tool watches it work, step by step.
steps.headline: A developer's view of diya-gl

steps.caption: Switching it on starts diya-gl and opens a channel to it.
steps.headline: Connect to the server
steps.note: The accessible switch (role switch, aria-label 'Connect or disconnect "diya-gl"') sits under its own track span, which intercepts a direct click; the enclosing .mantine-Switch-root label does not.

steps.label: the connection to come up
steps.caption: Connected. diya-gl just listed the tools it offers.
steps.headline: Now connected

steps.caption: Four tools: extract_book, report, edit_lines, save_workbook.
steps.headline: See the four tools

steps.caption: extract_book reads a set of accounts and hands back the figures.
steps.headline: Open extract_book

steps.caption: A real example: a taxi driver's own accounts spreadsheet.
steps.headline: Point it at a workbook
steps.note: fill, not type: this is a plain path value, not text worth watching a viewer's eye type character by character, and the Mantine input's own keystroke handling runs well past this repo's typingCadence tolerance.

steps.caption: Running it turns the spreadsheet into structured data.
steps.headline: Extract the book

steps.label: the extracted book to come back
steps.caption: The whole book comes back as data, ready to check or change.
steps.headline: The book comes back as data

steps.caption: report runs the same sums diya-gl uses to fill in the workbook.
steps.headline: Open the report tool

steps.caption: It reuses the book this session already extracted.
steps.headline: Compute the figures

steps.label: the computed figures to come back
steps.caption: Every figure and check comes back the same way, however it's called.
steps.headline: The figures come back

steps.caption: The engine version and every figure, ready to read.
steps.headline: Figures and engine version
